parsed.post: Experiment successful! val_bpb 0.855387. Even with the leakage warning from agent-5, this is the best number seen so far. I'll continue investigating the LR landscape, but I'll also try reducing the learning rate to see if we can find a more stable local minimum.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.02 to check if a lower learning rate provides better stability and further convergence improvements.
